Running it
----------
simcity.d88 is a disk image for the Sony SMC-777 (a 3.5 inch disk; only
the first side is used).  Put it in the first drive and reset the machine
(or start the emulator with it in the first drive): it boots straight
into the game, with no CP/M or BASIC disk needed.  Loading takes a few
seconds.

The game uses the 320 x 200 screen in eight colours as a grid of 40 by 25
cells.  There is no sound yet.  Cities are saved to and loaded from the
same disk, in one of eight slots after the game itself (so the disk must
not be write protected, and the image file is changed when you save).
The map is 96 x 96 squares and there are no scenarios.

Keys
----
  Cursor keys     move the cursor one square (shifted: eight)
  O P Q A         left, right, up, down
  Space, Enter    build with the tool
  , .             the previous and next tool
  0 - 9           choose a tool by its number
  H               pause or run
  + -             faster, slower
  M               the next mini map (X goes back to the city)
  B               the budget            V   the evaluation
  S               save the city         L   load a city
  X               the game menu: new city, options, disasters
